result.brief: 构建基于 Isaac Lab 数字孪生的 SO-101 语言条件空间操作仿真基准，评测 VLA 与世界-动作模型并验证仿真与真机排序一致性。
result.reason: Simulated SO-101 benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation, evaluating VLAs and world-action models; main contribution is benchmark/simulation, not representation or world model itself.
